newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany awards Viag public phone licence.
newsitem.headline: Germany awards Viag public phone licence.

text.p: Germany on Friday awarded Viag Interkom GmbH, the British-German telecommunications joint venture, a Class 4 licence to operate a national public telephone network when markets are deregulated in 1998.
Viag Interkom is owned by German utility Viag and telecoms group British Telecom Plc.

The government also said it awarded a Class 3 licence regulating telecommunications transmission networks for data, but not for public voice communication, to M'Net Telekommunikations GmbH for services in the city of Munich and neighboring Unterfoehring.
